quotes.quote: All that is gold does not glitter,Not all those who wander are lost;The old that is strong does not wither,Deep roots are not reached by the frost.From the ashes a fire shall be woken,A light from the shadows shall spring;Renewed shall be blade that was broken,The crownless again shall be king.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where. I love you simply, without problems or pride: I love you in this way because I do not know any other way of loving but this, in which there is no I or you, so intimate that your hand upon my chest is my hand, so intimate that when I fall asleep your eyes close.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda,  100 Love Sonnets

quotes.quote: Literature is the art of discovering something extraordinary about ordinary people, and saying with ordinary words something extraordinary.
quotes.author: Boris Pasternak

quotes.quote: Politics is the art of controlling your environment.
quotes.author: Hunter S. Thompson

quotes.quote: Advertising is the art of convincing people to spend money they don't have for something they don't need.
quotes.author: Will Rogers

quotes.quote: Just as pure abstract art is not dogmatic, neither is it decorative.
quotes.author: Piet Mondrian

quotes.quote: Don't only practice your art, but force your way into its secrets; art deserves that, for it and knowledge can raise man to the Divine.
quotes.author: Ludwig van Beethoven

quotes.quote: Architecture is the art of how to waste space.
quotes.author: Philip Johnson

quotes.quote: People discuss my art and pretend to understand as if it were necessary to understand, when it's simply necessary to love.
quotes.author: Claude Monet

quotes.quote: Space is the breath of art.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.quote: Science fiction is any idea that occurs in the head and doesn't exist yet, but soon will, and will change everything for everybody, and nothing will ever be the same again. As soon as you have an idea that changes some small part of the world you are writing science fiction. It is always the art of the possible, never the impossible.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: There is nothing in the world of art like the songs mother used to sing.
quotes.author: Billy Sunday

quotes.quote: Every bit of me is devoted to love and art. And I aspire to try to be a teacher to my young fans who feel just like I felt when I was younger. I just felt like a freak. I guess what I'm trying to say is I'm trying to liberate them, I want to free them of their fears and make them feel that they can make their own space in the world.
quotes.author: Lady Gaga

quotes.quote: The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and science.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: I consider skateboarding an art form, a lifestyle and a sport. 'Action sport' would be the least offensive categorization.
quotes.author: Tony Hawk

quotes.quote: Tact is the art of making a point without making an enemy.
quotes.author: Isaac Newton

quotes.quote: Where thou art, that is home.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.quote: Filmmaking, like any other art, is a very profound means of human communication; beyond the professional pleasure of succeeding or the pain of failing, you do want your film to be seen, to communicate itself to other people.
quotes.author: Kenneth Lonergan

quotes.quote: The art of simplicity is a puzzle of complexity.
quotes.author: Douglas Horton

quotes.quote: In art, the obvious is a sin.
quotes.author: Edward Dmytryk

quotes.quote: The art of healing comes from nature, not from the physician. Therefore the physician must start from nature, with an open mind.
quotes.author: Paracelsus

quotes.quote: Minimal art went nowhere.
quotes.author: Sol LeWitt

quotes.quote: Perhaps it's good for one to suffer. Can an artist do anything if he's happy? Would he ever want to do anything? What is art, after all, but a protest against the horrible inclemency of life?
quotes.author: Aldous Huxley

quotes.quote: I think you can do anything with comics that you could do in just about any art form.
quotes.author: Harvey Pekar

quotes.quote: When the bright angel dominates, out comes a great work of art, a Michelangelo David or a Beethoven symphony.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.quote: All art constantly aspires towards the condition of music.
quotes.author: Walter Pater

quotes.quote: I am my own experiment. I am my own work of art.
quotes.author: Madonna Ciccone

quotes.quote: I am a real person that cares about his art and cares about what he's doing - I have a heart and a soul and want to touch people and give.
quotes.author: LL Cool J

quotes.quote: Even a true artist does not always produce art.
quotes.author: Carroll O'Connor

quotes.quote: Every artist writes his own autobiography.
quotes.author: Havelock Ellis

quotes.quote: When I am finishing a picture, I hold some God-made object up to it - a rock, a flower, the branch of a tree or my hand - as a final test. If the painting stands up beside a thing man cannot make, the painting is authentic. If there's a clash between the two, it's bad art.
quotes.author: Marc Chagall

quotes.quote: Draw your pleasure, paint your pleasure, and express your pleasure strongly.
quotes.author: Pierre Bonnard

quotes.quote: A great artist can paint a great picture on a small canvas.
quotes.author: Charles Dudley Warner

quotes.quote: That's the motivation of an artist - to seek attention of some kind.
quotes.author: James Taylor

quotes.quote: Every other artist begins with a blank canvas, a piece of paper the photographer begins with the finished product.
quotes.author: Edward Steichen

quotes.quote: My attitude towards drawing is not necessarily about drawing. It's about making the best kind of image I can make, it's about talking as clearly as I can.
quotes.author: Jim Dine

quotes.quote: Where the spirit does not work with the hand, there is no art.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.quote: Art is the only way to run away without leaving home.
quotes.author: Twyla Tharp

quotes.quote: Every artist dips his brush in his own soul, and paints his own nature into his pictures.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: A picture is a poem without words.
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.quote: I have no fear of making changes, destroying the image, etc., because the painting has a life of its own.
quotes.author: Jackson Pollock

quotes.quote: To me, photography is the simultaneous recognition, in a fraction of a second, of the significance of an event.
quotes.author: Henri Cartier-Bresson

quotes.quote: Every picture shows a spot with which the artist has fallen in love.
quotes.author: Alfred Sisley

quotes.quote: Good art is art that allows you to enter it from a variety of angles and to emerge with a variety of views.
quotes.author: Mary Schmich

quotes.quote: All art is a struggle to be, in a particular sort of way, virtuous.
quotes.author: Iris Murdoch

quotes.quote: The creative act lasts but a brief moment, a lightning instant of give-and-take, just long enough for you to level the camera and to trap the fleeting prey in your little box.
quotes.author: Henri Cartier-Bresson

quotes.quote: The goal of art was the vital expression of self.
quotes.author: Alfred Stieglitz

quotes.quote: Photography is a major force in explaining man to man.
quotes.author: Edward Steichen

quotes.quote: An empty canvas is full.
quotes.author: Robert Rauschenberg

quotes.quote: I see myself and many artists like me as the torchbearers through these dark ages.
quotes.author: John Zorn

quotes.quote: The sculptor produces the beautiful statue by chipping away such parts of the marble block as are not needed - it is a process of elimination.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: One eye sees, the other feels.
quotes.author: Paul Klee

quotes.quote: In art as in love, instinct is enough.
quotes.author: Anatole France

quotes.quote: A beautiful body perishes, but a work of art dies not.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.quote: Art resides in the quality of doing, process is not magic.
quotes.author: Charles Eames

quotes.quote: True art is characterized by an irresistible urge in the creative artist.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: If you cannot learn to love real art, at least learn to hate sham art and reject it.
quotes.author: William Morris

quotes.quote: All art is dependent on technology because it's a human endeavour, so even when you're using charcoal on a wall or designed the proscenium arch, that's technology.
quotes.author: George Lucas

quotes.quote: I am enough of an artist to draw freely upon my imagination.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: A room hung with pictures is a room hung with thoughts.
quotes.author: Joshua Reynolds

quotes.quote: A sculptor is a person who is interested in the shape of things, a poet in words, a musician by sounds.
quotes.author: Henry Moore

quotes.quote: When I make art, I think about its ability to connect with others, to bring them into the process.
quotes.author: Jim Hodges

quotes.quote: I don't want life to imitate art. I want life to be art.
quotes.author: Ernst Fischer

quotes.quote: Artists don't make objects. Artists make mythologies.
quotes.author: Anish Kapoor

quotes.quote: All good art is an indiscretion.
quotes.author: Tennessee Williams

quotes.quote: Art is the unceasing effort to compete with the beauty of flowers - and never succeeding.
quotes.author: Gian Carlo Menotti

quotes.quote: We have art in order not to die of the truth.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: When I work, and in my art, I hold hands with God.
quotes.author: Robert Mapplethorpe

quotes.quote: The basis of art is truth, both in matter and in mode.
quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor

quotes.quote: I don't think there's any artist of any value who doesn't doubt what they're doing.
quotes.author: Francis Ford Coppola

quotes.quote: The mediator of the inexpressible is the work of art.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: The principles of true art is not to portray, but to evoke.
quotes.author: Jerzy Kosinski

quotes.quote: Painting and writing are solitary arts.
quotes.author: Conrad Hall

quotes.quote: Art in Nature is rhythmic and has a horror of constraint.
quotes.author: Robert Delaunay

quotes.quote: Pictures must not be too picturesque.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Without freedom, no art; art lives only on the restraints it imposes on itself, and dies of all others.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Personality is everything in art and poetry.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: It is after all the greatest art to limit and isolate oneself.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: The terrifying and edible beauty of Art Nouveau architecture.
quotes.author: Salvador Dali

quotes.quote: Art is science made clear.
quotes.author: Wilson Mizner

quotes.quote: Gossip is the art of saying nothing in a way that leaves practically nothing unsaid.
quotes.author: Walter Winchell

quotes.quote: Photography is more than a medium for factual communication of ideas. It is a creative art.
quotes.author: Ansel Adams

quotes.quote: Sculpture is the art of the intelligence.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.quote: One does not need buildings, money, power, or status to practice the Art of Peace. Heaven is right where you are standing, and that is the place to train.
quotes.author: Morihei Ueshiba

quotes.quote: Winners have the ability to step back from the canvas of their lives like an artist gaining perspective. They make their lives a work of art - an individual masterpiece.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: To array a man's will against his sickness is the supreme art of medicine.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: And the first rude sketch that the world had seen was joy to his mighty heart, till the Devil whispered behind the leaves 'It's pretty, but is it Art?'
quotes.author: Rudyard Kipling

quotes.quote: O, thou art fairer than the evening air clad in the beauty of a thousand stars.
quotes.author: Christopher Marlowe

quotes.quote: A good mother remembers to serve fruit at breakfast, is always cheerful and never yells, manages not to project her own neuroses and inadequacies onto her children, is an active and beloved community volunteer. She remembers to make play dates, her children's clothes fit, she does art projects with them and enjoys all their games.
quotes.author: Ayelet Waldman

quotes.quote: Patience is the art of concealing your impatience.
quotes.author: Guy Kawasaki

quotes.quote: A great city, whose image dwells in the memory of man, is the type of some great idea. Rome represents conquest; Faith hovers over the towers of Jerusalem; and Athens embodies the pre-eminent quality of the antique world, Art.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: I am not a great cook, I am not a great artist, but I love art, and I love food, so I am the perfect traveller.
quotes.author: Michael Palin

quotes.quote: I don't think about art when I'm working. I try to think about life.
quotes.author: Jean-Michel Basquiat

quotes.quote: Simplicity is the final achievement. After one has played a vast quantity of notes and more notes, it is simplicity that emerges as the crowning reward of art.
quotes.author: Frederic Chopin

quotes.quote: We can learn the art of fierce compassion - redefining strength, deconstructing isolation and renewing a sense of community, practicing letting go of rigid us-vs.-them thinking - while cultivating power and clarity in response to difficult situations.
quotes.author: Sharon Salzberg

quotes.quote: Art cannot be modern. Art is primordially eternal.
quotes.author: Egon Schiele

quotes.quote: I'm free. I just do what I want, say what I want, say how I feel, and I don't try to hurt nobody. I just try to make sure that I don't compromise my art in any kind of way, and I think people respect that.
quotes.author: Erykah Badu

quotes.quote: A compromise is the art of dividing a cake in such a way that everyone believes he has the biggest piece.
quotes.author: Ludwig Erhard

quotes.quote: I'm inspired by artists and musicians. There are so many wonderful and talented people in the world. I love discovering new music, new writers, or new art.
quotes.author: Alicia Keys

quotes.quote: The walls between art and engineering exist only in our minds.
quotes.author: Theo Jansen

quotes.quote: The temple of art is built in words.
quotes.author: Josiah Gilbert Holland

quotes.quote: The art of progress is to preserve order amid change and to preserve change amid order.
quotes.author: Alfred North Whitehead

quotes.quote: The ability to make somebody feel something: that's art. However you look at it, whether you're an author, a painter, a singer, a rapper, a spoken-word artist - art.
quotes.author: Wale

quotes.quote: As a longtime fan of talk radio, I'm very worried about the low opinion that conservative hosts and callers have of the American artist. Art is portrayed as a scam, a rip-off and snow job pushed by snobbish elites.
quotes.author: Camille Paglia

quotes.quote: I've constantly tried new things, even as a child, and have always been obsessed with pink. Now I'm just a little more ladylike and fearless. You should never feel afraid to become a piece of art. It's exhilarating.
quotes.author: Nicki Minaj

quotes.quote: In any art, you don't know in advance what you want to say - it's revealed to you as you say it. That's the difference between art and illustration.
quotes.author: Aaron Siskind

quotes.quote: Music happens to be an art form that transcends language.
quotes.author: Herbie Hancock

quotes.quote: In our life there is a single color, as on an artist's palette, which provides the meaning of life and art. It is the color of love.
quotes.author: Marc Chagall

quotes.quote: Life is the art of drawing sufficient conclusions from insufficient premises.
quotes.author: Samuel Butler

quotes.quote: We are all hungry and thirsty for concrete images. Abstract art will have been good for one thing: to restore its exact virginity to figurative art.
quotes.author: Salvador Dali

quotes.quote: Life is not an exact science, it is an art.
quotes.author: Samuel Butler

quotes.quote: The art of a people is a true mirror to their minds.
quotes.author: Jawaharlal Nehru

quotes.quote: Film will only became an art when its materials are as inexpensive as pencil and paper.
quotes.author: Jean Cocteau

quotes.quote: The art and science of asking questions is the source of all knowledge.
quotes.author: Thomas Berger

quotes.quote: Raising children is a creative endeavor, an art rather than a science.
quotes.author: Bruno Bettelheim

quotes.quote: You should never feel afraid to become a piece of art. It's exhilarating.
quotes.author: Nicki Minaj

quotes.quote: A work of art when placed in a gallery loses its charge, and becomes a portable object or surface disengaged from the outside world.
quotes.author: Robert Smithson

quotes.quote: What 'War and Peace' is to the novel and 'Hamlet' is to the theater, Swan Lake' is to ballet - that is, the name which to many people stands for and sums up an art form.
quotes.author: Robert Gottlieb

quotes.quote: Pop Art looks out into the world. It doesn't look like a painting of something, it looks like the thing itself.
quotes.author: Roy Lichtenstein

quotes.quote: The roles of art, morality, religion, political faith, science itself are not to repair organic exhaustion nor to provide sound functioning of the organs. All this supraphysical life is built and expanded not because of the demands of the cosmic environment but because of the demands of the social environment.
quotes.author: Emile Durkheim

quotes.quote: Let's face it: professing a deep interest in movies, the absolutely dominant global art form of the last century, is at this point like professing an interest in air. Passion is nice. Erudition is admirable. But it's like that moment when good manners cross over into meaningless etiquette.
quotes.author: David Rakoff

quotes.quote: I used to go and flatten my nose against that window and absorb all I could of his art. It changed my life. I saw art then as I wanted to see it.
quotes.author: Mary Cassatt

quotes.quote: Photographing a cake can be art.
quotes.author: Irving Penn

quotes.quote: As a child I was very into gadgets and machines and robots. The idea of experimenting with machines to create art was always something I tinkered with.
quotes.author: Reggie Watts

quotes.quote: When I travel, I draw and paint sketches which is great fun. And as long as you are fully aware that it has nothing to do with actual art, I think that's all right.
quotes.author: Arne Jacobsen

quotes.quote: It's the word 'artful'; it's such a great word, with its dark and its light side, its art and its cunning, the craft and the crafty of it - I've been preoccupied with the word 'artful' and the twin notions of 'cornucopia' and 'pickpocket' it suggests for quite some time.
quotes.author: Ali Smith

quotes.quote: Love of beauty is taste. The creation of beauty is art.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Speak the truth, do not yield to anger; give, if thou art asked for little; by these three steps thou wilt go near the gods.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: There's no art to find the mind's construction in the face.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: 'Crazy' is a term of art; 'Insane' is a term of law. Remember that, and you will save yourself a lot of trouble.
quotes.author: Hunter S. Thompson

quotes.quote: I think in art, but especially in films, people are trying to confirm their own existences.
quotes.author: Jim Morrison

quotes.quote: Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.quote: Art is the stored honey of the human soul, gathered on wings of misery and travail.
quotes.author: Theodore Dreiser

quotes.quote: Art begins with resistance - at the point where resistance is overcome. No human masterpiece has ever been created without great labor.
quotes.author: Andre Gide

quotes.quote: I hope to live all my life for my art, without abandoning my principles one iota.
quotes.author: Gustave Courbet

quotes.quote: The principle of art is to pause, not bypass.
quotes.author: Jerzy Kosinski

quotes.quote: It may be that the deep necessity of art is the examination of self-deception.
quotes.author: Robert Motherwell

quotes.quote: Painting is a nail to which I fasten my ideas.
quotes.author: Georges Braque

quotes.quote: Vulnerability is the essence of romance. It's the art of being uncalculated, the willingness to look foolish, the courage to say, 'This is me, and I'm interested in you enough to show you my flaws with the hope that you may embrace me for all that I am but, more important, all that I am not.'
quotes.author: Ashton Kutcher

quotes.quote: Art must take reality by surprise.
quotes.author: Francoise Sagan

quotes.quote: What I wanted to do was to paint sunlight on the side of a house.
quotes.author: Edward Hopper

quotes.quote: Art enables us to find ourselves and lose ourselves at the same time.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: Pictures deface walls more often than they decorate them.
quotes.author: William Wordsworth

quotes.quote: The mission of art is to represent nature not to imitate her.
quotes.author: William Morris Hunt

quotes.quote: Art is the daughter of freedom.
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.quote: The artist is nothing without the gift, but the gift is nothing without work.
quotes.author: Emile Zola

quotes.quote: An artist is not paid for his labor but for his vision.
quotes.author: James Whistler

quotes.quote: What makes photography a strange invention is that its primary raw materials are light and time.
quotes.author: John Berger

quotes.quote: When I think of art I think of beauty. Beauty is the mystery of life. It is not in the eye it is in the mind. In our minds there is awareness of perfection.
quotes.author: Agnes Martin

quotes.quote: My hand is the extension of the thinking process - the creative process.
quotes.author: Tadao Ando

quotes.quote: Every artist was first an amateur.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: To send light into the darkness of men's hearts - such is the duty of the artist.
quotes.author: Robert Schumann

quotes.quote: The very essence of the creative is its novelty, and hence we have no standard by which to judge it.
quotes.author: Carl Rogers

quotes.quote: The artist's world is limitless. It can be found anywhere, far from where he lives or a few feet away. It is always on his doorstep.
quotes.author: Paul Strand

quotes.quote: I love you as certain dark things are to be loved, in secret, between the shadow and the soul.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda,  100 Love Sonnets

quotes.quote: No great artist ever sees things as they really are. If he did, he would cease to be an artist.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: If art is to nourish the roots of our culture, society must set the artist free to follow his vision wherever it takes him.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: An artist cannot fail; it is a success to be one.
quotes.author: Charles Horton Cooley

quotes.quote: Very few people possess true artistic ability. It is therefore both unseemly and unproductive to irritate the situation by making an effort. If you have a burning, restless urge to write or paint, simply eat something sweet and the feeling will pass.
quotes.author: Fran Lebowitz

quotes.quote: When one paints an ideal, one does not need to limit one's imagination.
quotes.author: Ellen Key

quotes.quote: This is part of the involuntary bargain we make with the world just by being alive. We get to experiences the splendor of nature, the beauty of art, the balm of love and the sheer joy of existence, always with the knowledge that illness, injury, natural disaster, or pure evil can end it in an instant for ourselves or someone we love.
quotes.author: Jeff Greenfield

quotes.quote: Music has the power to bring people together like no other art form.
quotes.author: Michael Franti

quotes.quote: An artist never works under ideal conditions. If they existed, his work wouldn't exist, for the artist doesn't live in a vacuum. Some sort of pressure must exist. The artist exists because the world is not perfect. Art would be useless if the world were perfect, as man wouldn't look for harmony but would simply live in it.
quotes.author: Andrei Tarkovsky

quotes.quote: There was a manifesto in the late '60s/early '70s, and it basically laid out what 'black art' was and that it should embrace black history and black culture. There were all these rules - I was shocked, when I found it in a book, that it even existed, that it would demarcate these artists.
quotes.author: Kara Walker

quotes.quote: I wasn't exposed to art as I was growing up, and can't recall the first time I saw a work of art. However, I remember very clearly a vision I had of a little green reindeer when I was a child, and visions emanate from the same mythical area where painting resides. Whatever the reason, I immediately felt comfortable working with visual materials.
quotes.author: William S. Burroughs

quotes.quote: I have trouble with modern art. But in general, all art forms fascinate me - art is the way human beings express what we can't say in words.
quotes.author: Andrea Bocelli

quotes.quote: The work of art is always unfaithful to its creator... Art lays at a higher level; it says something more, and almost always, it says something different from what the artist wanted to say.
quotes.author: Octavio Paz

quotes.quote: They teach you there's a boundary line to music. But, man, there's no boundary line to art.
quotes.author: Charlie Parker

quotes.quote: Life is short, the art long.
quotes.author: Hippocrates

quotes.quote: Philosophy and Art both render the invisible visible by imagination.
quotes.author: George Henry Lewes

quotes.quote: Art is a critical component in a well-rounded education. Art is the level playing field - no matter how rich or poor, tall or short, pretty or ugly to the bone, if you can draw, you can find personal fulfillment and build self-confidence. Art is the highest achievement of mankind.
quotes.author: Lynda Resnick

quotes.quote: Art and Religion are, then, two roads by which men escape from circumstance to ecstasy. Between aesthetic and religious rapture there is a family alliance. Art and Religion are means to similar states of mind.
quotes.author: Clive Bell

quotes.quote: I think that that's why artists make art - it is difficult to put into words unless you are a poet. What it takes is being open to the flow of universal creativity. The Zen artists knew this.
quotes.author: Alex Grey

quotes.quote: I got my first camera when I was 21 - my boyfriend gave it to me for my birthday - but at that point politics was my life, and I viewed the camera as a tool for expressing my political beliefs rather than as an art medium.
quotes.author: Carrie Mae Weems

quotes.quote: A performance art piece is unprecedented. It is difficult to censor since it has a good possibility of never being done before.
quotes.author: Jack Bowman

quotes.quote: There is something about giving everything to your profession. In Italian, an obsession is not necessarily negative. It's the art of putting all your energy into one thing; it's the art of transforming even what you eat for lunch into architecture.
quotes.author: Renzo Piano

quotes.quote: Graffiti's always been a temporary art form. You make your mark and then they scrub it off.
quotes.author: Banksy

quotes.quote: Religion is the everlasting dialogue between humanity and God. Art is its soliloquy.
quotes.author: Franz Werfel

quotes.quote: Art to me is an anecdote of the spirit, and the only means of making concrete the purpose of its varied quickness and stillness.
quotes.author: Mark Rothko

quotes.quote: In the practical art of war, the best thing of all is to take the enemy's country whole and intact; to shatter and destroy it is not so good.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Cunning is the art of concealing our own defects, and discovering other people's weaknesses.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: Courtesy is a silver lining around the dark clouds of civilization; it is the best part of refinement and in many ways, an art of heroic beauty in the vast gallery of man's cruelty and baseness.
quotes.author: Bryant H. McGill

quotes.quote: Art is the most beautiful of all lies.
quotes.author: Claude Debussy

quotes.quote: No great art has ever been made without the artist having known danger.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quotes.quote: Art is a way to express yourself and through that you can escape a bad situation.
quotes.author: Russell Simmons

quotes.quote: Some songs you get. Some songs you may not. And I think that's the beauty of art: to question and to ask, to understand the deeper meaning after two or three or four listenings.
quotes.author: Janelle Monae

quotes.quote: Cultural confinement takes place when a curator imposes his own limits on an art exhibition, rather than asking an artist to set his limits.
quotes.author: Robert Smithson

quotes.quote: Nature is the art of God.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: I think most of the people involved in any art always secretly wonder whether they are really there because they're good or there because they're lucky.
quotes.author: Katharine Hepburn

quotes.quote: Professionalism in art has this difficulty: To be professional is to be dependable, to be dependable is to be predictable, and predictability is esthetically boring - an anti-virtue in a field where we hope to be astonished and startled and at some deep level refreshed.
quotes.author: John Updike

quotes.quote: I think it's the pain and suffering that drive you to become an artist. The art itself should be the pain, sort of exorcising every demon and making you feel like you're a person that matters.
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: Translation is the art of failure.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco

quotes.quote: All the art of living lies in a fine mingling of letting go and holding on.
quotes.author: Havelock Ellis

quotes.quote: Thought is more important than art. To revere art and have no understanding of the process that forces it into existence, is finally not even to understand what art is.
quotes.author: Amiri Baraka

quotes.quote: Advertising is fundamentally persuasion and persuasion happens to be not a science, but an art.
quotes.author: William Bernbach

quotes.quote: American art in general... takes to surreal exaggerations and metaphors; but its Puritan work ethic has little use for the playful self-indulgence behind Parisian Surrealism.
quotes.author: John Updike

quotes.quote: I'm into sincerity in music and sincerity in art. If it doesn't feel true, I don't want to do it. Things that are too dramatic scare me. I think that's why I don't always fit into the world of performing arts.
quotes.author: Zooey Deschanel

quotes.quote: Art has a double visage: it looks before and after. Romance is its forward-looking face. The germ of growth is in romanticism. Formalism, on the other hand, consolidates tradition; gleans what has been gained and makes it facile to the hand or the mind; economizes the energy of genius.
quotes.author: George Edward Woodberry

quotes.quote: The art of medicine was to be properly learned only from its practice and its exercise.
quotes.author: Thomas Sydenham

quotes.quote: Every great work of art has two faces, one toward its own time and one toward the future, toward eternity.
quotes.author: Lester Bangs

quotes.quote: Some people have been kind enough to call me a fine artist. I've always called myself an illustrator. I'm not sure what the difference is. All I know is that whatever type of work I do, I try to give it my very best. Art has been my life.
quotes.author: Norman Rockwell

quotes.quote: Because it's so easy to medicate our need for self-worth by pandering to win followers, 'likes' and view counts, social media have become the metier of choice for many people who might otherwise channel that energy into books, music or art - or even into their own Web ventures.
quotes.author: Neil Strauss

quotes.quote: I'm not really sure what social message my art carries, if any. And I don't really want it to carry one. I'm not interested in the subject matter to try to teach society anything, or to try to better our world in any way.
quotes.author: Roy Lichtenstein

quotes.quote: Everyone in those days expected that art students were wild, licentious characters. We didn't know how to be, but we sure were anxious to learn.
quotes.author: Norman Rockwell

quotes.quote: I am an artisan. I only became an artist when people watch what I do. That is when it becomes art.
quotes.author: Rhys Ifans

quotes.quote: Making sushi is an art, and experience is everything.
quotes.author: Nobu Matsuhisa

quotes.quote: Life is an illusion. I am held together in the nothingness by art.
quotes.author: Anselm Kiefer

quotes.quote: At no point do I wish to be in conflict with any man or masculine thought. It doesn't enter my consciousness. Art is anonymous. It's not competitive with men. It's a complementary contribution.
quotes.author: Barbara Hepworth

quotes.quote: Art and nature shall always be wrestling until they eventually conquer one another so that the victory is the same stroke and line: that which is conquered, conquers at the same time.
quotes.author: Maria Sibylla Merian

quotes.quote: Art is individualism, and individualism is a disturbing and disintegrating force.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Bad people are, from the point of view of art, fascinating studies. They represent colour, variety and strangeness. Good people exasperate one's reason; bad people stir one's imagination.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: I collect art, and I drink wine... things that I like that I had never been exposed to. But I never said, 'I'm going to buy art to impress this crowd.' That's just ridiculous to me. I don't live my life like that, because how could you be happy with yourself?
quotes.author: Jay-Z

quotes.quote: Art, as far as it is able, follows nature, as a pupil imitates his master; thus your art must be, as it were, God's grandchild.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: Music expresses that which cannot be put into words and that which cannot remain silent
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: What strikes me is the fact that in our society, art has become something which is only related to objects, and not to individuals, or to life.
quotes.author: Michel Foucault

quotes.quote: Art is the symbol of the two noblest human efforts: to construct and to refrain from destruction.
quotes.author: Evelyn Waugh

quotes.quote: The chief function of the city is to convert power into form, energy into culture, dead matter into the living symbols of art, biological reproduction into social creativity.
quotes.author: Lewis Mumford

quotes.quote: Works of art, in my opinion, are the only objects in the material universe to possess internal order, and that is why, though I don't believe that only art matters, I do believe in Art for Art's sake.
quotes.author: E. M. Forster

quotes.quote: Culture is the arts elevated to a set of beliefs.
quotes.author: Thomas Wolfe

quotes.quote: As a kid, I loved 'Godot' because of the poetry and the humor and the strangeness, but then as you get older, it's much more resonant.
quotes.author: Nathan Lane

quotes.quote: Trifles make perfection, and perfection is no trifle.
quotes.author: Michelangelo

quotes.quote: Fashion is only the attempt to realize art in living forms and social intercourse.
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.quote: I like to pretend that my art has nothing to do with me.
quotes.author: Roy Lichtenstein

quotes.quote: Art is the child of Nature; yes, her darling child, in whom we trace the features of the mother's face, her aspect and her attitude.
quotes.author: Beck

quotes.quote: I choose a block of marble and chop off whatever I don't need.
quotes.author: Auguste Rodin

quotes.quote: Only the very weak-minded refuse to be influenced by literature and poetry.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

quotes.quote: Drawing is the honesty of the art. There is no possibility of cheating. It is either good or bad.
quotes.author: Salvador Dali

quotes.quote: Painting is just another way of keeping a diary.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.quote: Painting is self-discovery. Every good artist paints what he is.
quotes.author: Jackson Pollock

quotes.quote: Art is making something out of nothing and selling it.
quotes.author: Frank Zappa

quotes.quote: Art, like morality, consists in drawing the line somewhere.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: Life beats down and crushes the soul and art reminds you that you have one.
quotes.author: Stella Adler

quotes.quote: Art is the concrete representation of our most subtle feelings.
quotes.author: Agnes Martin

quotes.quote: I do not want art for a few any more than education for a few, or freedom for a few.
quotes.author: William Morris

quotes.quote: Summer is a great time to visit art museums, which offer the refreshing rinse of swimming pools - only instead of cool water, you immerse yourself in art.
quotes.author: Jerry Saltz

quotes.quote: Without tradition, art is a flock of sheep without a shepherd. Without innovation, it is a corpse.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.quote: Art has to move you and design does not, unless it's a good design for a bus.
quotes.author: David Hockney

quotes.quote: What art offers is space - a certain breathing room for the spirit.
quotes.author: John Updike

quotes.quote: All art is autobiographical. The pearl is the oyster's autobiography.
quotes.author: Federico Fellini

quotes.quote: Art requires philosophy, just as philosophy requires art. Otherwise, what would become of beauty?
quotes.author: Paul Gauguin

quotes.quote: Without art, the crudeness of reality would make the world unbearable.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: An intellectual says a simple thing in a hard way. An artist says a hard thing in a simple way.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.quote: We love the things we love for what they are.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.quote: I don't want to be interesting. I want to be good.
quotes.author: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe

quotes.quote: It is not in life, but in art that self-fulfillment is to be found.
quotes.author: Wilson Mizner

quotes.quote: I think of art, at its most significant, as a DEW line, a Distant Early Warning system that can always be relied on to tell the old culture what is beginning to happen to it.
quotes.author: Marshall McLuhan

quotes.quote: If you go back to the Greeks and Romans, they talk about all three - wine, food, and art - as a way of enhancing life.
quotes.author: Robert Mondavi

quotes.quote: The art of war is of vital importance to the state. It is a matter of life and death, a road either to safety or to ruin. Hence it is a subject of inquiry which can on no account be neglected.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: There is no philosophy without the art of ignoring objections.
quotes.author: Joseph de Maistre

quotes.quote: Geometry is moribund. I want a lilt and joy to art.
quotes.author: Ellsworth Kelly

quotes.quote: The recognition of the art that informs all pure science need not mean the abandonment for it of all present art, rather it will mean the completion of the transformation of art that has already begun.
quotes.author: John Desmond Bernal

quotes.quote: I dug up some old John Buscema 'Conan' comics. Man, when Alfredo Alcala was inking, that was some of the most beautiful black and white comic art ever published. The stories are good, too, though early '70s comics based on Conan is a festival of sexist, racist stereotypes.
quotes.author: Ted Naifeh

quotes.quote: I think art is the only thing that's spiritual in the world. And I refuse to forced to believe in other people's interpretations of God. I don't think anybody should be. No one person can own the copyright to what God means.
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: For thousands of years, human beings have been obsessed with beauty, truth, love, honor, altruism, courage, social relationships, art, and God. They all go together as subjective experiences, and it's a straw man to set God up as the delusion. If he is, then so is truth itself or beauty itself.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: When we look back at the Mayans or ancient Egypt, we look at their art.
quotes.author: Robert Wilson

quotes.quote: Serious art has been the work of individual artists whose art has had nothing to do with style because they were not in the least connected with the style or the needs of the masses. Their work arose rather in defiance of their times.
quotes.author: Franz Marc

quotes.quote: To so enter into it in nature and art that the enjoyed meanings of life may become a part of living is the attitude of aesthetic appreciation.
quotes.author: George Herbert Mead

quotes.quote: Modesty: the gentle art of enhancing your charm by pretending not to be aware of it.
quotes.author: Oliver Herford

quotes.quote: I think music is the greatest art form that exists, and I think people listen to music for different reasons, and it serves different purposes. Some of it is background music, and some of it is things that might affect a person's day, if not their life, or change an attitude. The best songs are the ones that make you feel something.
quotes.author: Eddie Vedder

quotes.quote: Listen to your inner-voice: Surround yourself with loving, nurturing people. Fall in love with your art and find yourself. Music is the great communicator.
quotes.author: Glenn Hughes

quotes.quote: What thoughts are to the individual, art is to the community as a whole. That's where you reflect on who you are, who you hope to be, what you've gone through, and where you hope to go.
quotes.author: Wendell Pierce

quotes.quote: I'm a people person, very approachable. I go out every night, tons of functions. I love all facets of this industry... Music, film, TV, books, art. I love being around creative people.
quotes.author: Guy Oseary

quotes.quote: The art of life is to live in the present moment, and to make that moment as perfect as we can by the realization that we are the instruments and expression of God Himself.
quotes.author: Emmet Fox

quotes.quote: Even in modern art, artists have used methods based on calculation, inasmuch as these elements, alongside those of a more personal and emotional nature, give balance and harmony to any work of art.
quotes.author: Max Bill

quotes.quote: Great art speaks a language which every intelligent person can understand. The people who call themselves modernists today speak a different language.
quotes.author: Marshall McLuhan

quotes.quote: The momentous thing in human life is the art of winning the soul to good or evil.
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.quote: Through art, you create your own world.
quotes.author: Daphne Guinness

quotes.quote: Every mind which has given itself to self-expression in art is aware of a directing agency outside its conscious control which it has agreed to label 'inspiration'.
quotes.author: Norman Lindsay

quotes.quote: There is a lot that horses and art share in common. I have found that most horse people are art lovers, and vice versa.
quotes.author: Alice Walton

quotes.quote: Art is not necessary at all. All that is necessary to make this world a better place to live in is to love - to love as Christ loved, as Buddha loved.
quotes.author: Isadora Duncan

quotes.quote: When you think about Dada and the great moments in Modern Art, it's always the sense of when you're not sure that art is most likely to be occurring.
quotes.author: Richard Phillips

quotes.quote: When art dresses in worn-out material it is most easily recognized as art.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Art is always and everywhere the secret confession, and at the same time the immortal movement of its time.
quotes.author: Karl Marx

quotes.quote: Parents are usually more careful to bestow knowledge on their children rather than virtue, the art of speaking well rather than doing well; but their manners should be of the greatest concern.
quotes.author: R. Buckminster Fuller

quotes.quote: Mathematics is the art of giving the same name to different things.
quotes.author: Henri Poincare

quotes.quote: Art is accusation, expression, passion. Art is a fight to the finish between black charcoal and white paper.
quotes.author: Gunter Grass

quotes.quote: It is a myth that art has to be sold. It is not like stocking a grocery store where people fill a pushcart. Art is a product that has no apparent need. The salesperson builds the need in the mind of the buyer.
quotes.author: Jack White

quotes.quote: There are so many awful things in this world, but I wanted readers to share with me the small, beautiful, enjoyable things. Things like cute clothes, beautiful art and pretty flowers; items that are overflowing with beauty. If you just become obsessed with your own problems, you miss these things. When you discover them, you become happy.
quotes.author: Novala Takemoto

quotes.quote: Writing stopped being fun when I discovered the difference between good writing and bad and, even more terrifying, the difference between it and true art. And after that, the whip came down.
quotes.author: Truman Capote

quotes.quote: Medicine is a science of uncertainty and an art of probability.
quotes.author: William Osler

quotes.quote: What other people may find in poetry or art museums, I find in the flight of a good drive.
quotes.author: Arnold Palmer

quotes.quote: I did study the art of being a barber because I wanted to figure out what my routine would be. Do you start in the front or back? Top or bottom? Swivel the chair or walk around? What I did discover is there's no such thing as the perfect haircut!
quotes.author: Sean Patrick Thomas

quotes.quote: Washington, D.C., has everything that Rome, Paris and London have in the way of great architecture - great power bases. Washington has obelisks and pyramids and underground tunnels and great art and a whole shadow world that we really don't see.
quotes.author: Dan Brown

quotes.quote: Music is God's gift to man, the only art of Heaven given to earth, the only art of earth we take to Heaven.
quotes.author: Walter Savage Landor

quotes.quote: He who would do good to another must do it in Minute Particulars: general Good is the plea of the scoundrel, hypocrite, and flatterer, for Art and Science cannot exist but in minutely organized Particulars.
quotes.author: William Blake

quotes.quote: Dying is an art, like everything else. I do it exceptionally well. I do it so it feels like hell. I do it so it feels real. I guess you could say I've a call.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: A secondhand wardrobe hand clothes doesn't make one an artist. Neither do a hair-trigger temper, melancholic nature, propensity for tears, hating your parents, or HIV. I hate to say it - none of these make one an artist. They can help, but just as being gay doesn't make one witty... the only thing that makes one an artist is making art.
quotes.author: David Rakoff

quotes.quote: It is the spectator, and not life, that art really mirrors.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: I have never denied my background or my culture. I have taught my child to embrace her Mexican heritage, to love my first language, Spanish, to learn about Mexican history, music, folk art, food, and even the Mexican candy I grew up with.
quotes.author: Salma Hayek

quotes.quote: It is the function of art to renew our perception. What we are familiar with we cease to see. The writer shakes up the familiar scene, and, as if by magic, we see a new meaning in it.
quotes.author: Anais Nin

quotes.quote: In France, cooking is a serious art form and a national sport.
quotes.author: Julia Child

quotes.quote: I believe the target of anything in life should be to do it so well that it becomes an art.
quotes.author: Arsene Wenger

quotes.quote: I would be willing to do almost anything to make Art happy. I care about our friendship. The only thing I won't do is change the essence of my work.
quotes.author: Paul Simon

quotes.quote: Cleanliness is the scourge of art.
quotes.author: Craig Brown

quotes.quote: They say Princes learn no art truly, but the art of horsemanship. The reason is, the brave beast is no flatterer. He will throw a prince as soon as his groom.
quotes.author: Ben Jonson

quotes.quote: The artist must create a spark before he can make a fire and before art is born, the artist must be ready to be consumed by the fire of his own creation.
quotes.author: Auguste Rodin

quotes.quote: I was an awful critic. I operated on the assumption that there was an absolute scale of values against which art could be measured. I didn't trust my own subjective responses.
quotes.author: Tom Stoppard

quotes.quote: Layer by layer art strips life bare.
quotes.author: Robert Musil

quotes.quote: Real art is basic emotion. If a scene is handled with simplicity - and I don't mean simple - it'll be good, and the public will know it.
quotes.author: John Wayne

quotes.quote: There's design, and there's art. Good design is total harmony. There's no better designer than nature - if you look at a branch or a leaf, it's perfect. It's all function. Art is different. It's about emotion. It's about suffering and beauty - but mostly suffering!
quotes.author: Diane von Furstenberg

quotes.quote: Performance has to be mainstream art. This is what I'm fighting for.
quotes.author: Marina Abramovic

quotes.quote: I feel like skateboarding is as much of a sport as a lifestyle, and an art form, so there's so much that that transcends in terms of music, fashion, and entertainment.
quotes.author: Tony Hawk

quotes.quote: In visual perception a color is almost never seen as it really is - as it physically is. This fact makes color the most relative medium in art.
quotes.author: Josef Albers

quotes.quote: Our best teachers do more than impart facts and figures - they inspire and encourage students and instill a true desire to learn. That's a fine art in itself.
quotes.author: Sonny Perdue

quotes.quote: Making art is not the matter of a moment, and nor is making an exhibition; curating follows art.
quotes.author: Hans-Ulrich Obrist

quotes.quote: I used to stay up all night playing 'Resident Evil 2,' and it wouldn't stop until the sun came up. Then I'd walk outside at dawn's first light, looking at the empty streets of London, and it was like life imitating art. It felt like I'd stepped into an actual zombie apocalypse.
quotes.author: Edgar Wright

quotes.quote: For art to exist, for any sort of aesthetic activity to exist, a certain physiological precondition is indispensable: intoxication.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Admiration for a quality or an art can be so strong that it deters us from striving to possess it.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Yes, the Bible should be taught in our schools because it is necessary to understand the Bible if we are to truly understand our own culture and how it came to be. The Bible has influenced every part of western culture from our art, music, and history, to our sense of fairness, charity, and business.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: The great art of life is sensation, to feel that we exist, even in pain.
quotes.author: Lord Byron

quotes.quote: All things are artificial, for nature is the art of God.
quotes.author: Thomas Browne

quotes.quote: We live in an age when the traditional great subjects - the human form, the landscape, even newer traditions such as abstract expressionism - are daily devalued by commercial art.
quotes.author: Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: Feelings aroused by the touch of someone's hand, the sound of music, the smell of a flower, a beautiful sunset, a work of art, love, laughter, hope and faith - all work on both the unconscious and the conscious aspects of the self, and they have physiological consequences as well.
quotes.author: Bernie Siegel

quotes.quote: History has remembered the kings and warriors, because they destroyed; art has remembered the people, because they created.
quotes.author: William Morris

quotes.quote: Politics is the art of the possible.
quotes.author: Otto von Bismarck

quotes.quote: Football is an art, like dancing is an art - but only when it's well done does it become an art.
quotes.author: Arsene Wenger

quotes.quote: Ballet is an incredibly difficult, beautiful art form that takes a lot of training, a lot of time, and a lot of hard work.
quotes.author: Sutton Foster

quotes.quote: You wouldn't have the same art on the walls at every restaurant or the same waiter uniforms. Neither should you have the same service style at every restaurant.
quotes.author: Danny Meyer

quotes.quote: Part of what I do and what I want to do is I want to bring art into the everyday life. If you can take ordinary just walking in the street and you're confronted by something, that might change your day - it might inspire you.
quotes.author: Kenny Scharf

quotes.quote: Art is like baby shoes. When you coat them with gold, they can no longer be worn.
quotes.author: John Updike

quotes.quote: Reason clears and plants the wilderness of the imagination to harvest the wheat of art.
quotes.author: Austin O'Malley

quotes.quote: Architecture is basically the design of interiors, the art of organizing interior space.
quotes.author: Philip Johnson

quotes.quote: No art is less spontaneous than mine. What I do is the result of reflection and the study of the great masters.
quotes.author: Edgar Degas

quotes.quote: My motivation for being a good drummer was born out of fear, which, in a way, seems so antithetical to what art should be.
quotes.author: Damien Chazelle

quotes.quote: I think we're much smarter than we were. Everybody knows that abstract art can be art, and most people know that they may not like it, even if they understand there's another purpose to it.
quotes.author: Roy Lichtenstein

quotes.quote: In life, as in art, the beautiful moves in curves.
quotes.author: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

quotes.quote: You talk when you cease to be at peace with your thoughts.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

quotes.quote: Does art have a future? Performance genres like opera, theater, music and dance are thriving all over the world, but the visual arts have been in slow decline for nearly 40 years. No major figure of profound influence has emerged in painting or sculpture since the waning of Pop Art and the birth of Minimalism in the early 1970s.
quotes.author: Camille Paglia

quotes.quote: Art saved me; it got me through my depression and self-loathing, back to a place of innocence.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson

quotes.quote: Movies become art after editing. Instead of just reproducing reality, they juxtapose images of it. That implies expression; that's art.
quotes.author: Alejandro Gonzalez Inarritu

quotes.quote: During the Middle Ages they understood that words accompanied by imagery are much more memorable. By making the margins of a book colorful and beautiful, illuminations help make the text unforgettable. It's unfortunate that we've lost the art of illumination.
quotes.author: Joshua Foer

quotes.quote: Nature is inside art as its content, not outside as its model.
quotes.author: Marilyn French

quotes.quote: Even in literature and art, no man who bothers about originality will ever be original: whereas if you simply try to tell the truth (without caring twopence how often it has been told before) you will, nine times out of ten, become original without ever having noticed it.
quotes.author: C. S. Lewis

quotes.quote: I have seen many storms in my life. Most storms have caught me by surprise, so I had to learn very quickly to look further and understand that I am not capable of controlling the weather, to exercise the art of patience and to respect the fury of nature.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: To say nothing, especially when speaking, is half the art of diplomacy.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.quote: Love isn't an emotion or an instinct - it's an art.
quotes.author: Mae West

quotes.quote: Every happening, great and small, is a parable whereby God speaks to us, and the art of life is to get the message.
quotes.author: Malcolm Muggeridge

quotes.quote: It is not up to me whether I win or lose. Ultimately, this might not be my day. And it is that philosophy towards sports, something that I really truly live by. I am emotional. I want to win. I am hungry. I am a competitor. I have that fire. But deep down, I truly enjoy the art of competing so much more than the result.
quotes.author: Apolo Ohno

quotes.quote: Politics is the art of choosing between the disastrous and the unpalatable.
quotes.author: John Kenneth Galbraith

quotes.quote: Art is a marriage of the conscious and the unconscious.
quotes.author: Jean Cocteau

quotes.quote: Actually I think Art lies in both directions - the broad strokes, big picture but on the other hand the minute examination of the apparently mundane. Seeing the whole world in a grain of sand, that kind of thing.
quotes.author: Peter Hammill

quotes.quote: Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art... It has no survival value; rather it is one of those things that give value to survival.
quotes.author: C. S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Every heart sings a song, incomplete, until another heart whispers back. Those who wish to sing always find a song. At the touch of a lover, everyone becomes a poet.
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.quote: The art of acceptance is the art of making someone who has just done you a small favor wish that he might have done you a greater one.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: The art of love is largely the art of persistence.
quotes.author: Albert Ellis

quotes.quote: The art of teaching is the art of assisting discovery.
quotes.author: Mark Van Doren

quotes.quote: History develops, art stands still.
quotes.author: E. M. Forster

quotes.quote: Words may be false and full of art; Sighs are the natural language of the heart.
quotes.author: Thomas Shadwell

quotes.quote: Jazz music is America's past and its potential, summed up and sanctified and accessible to anybody who learns to listen to, feel, and understand it. The music can connect us to our earlier selves and to our better selves-to-come. It can remind us of where we fit on the time line of human achievement, an ultimate value of art.
quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis

quotes.quote: No art is any good unless you can feel how it's put together. By and large it's the eye, the hand and if it's any good, you feel the body. Most of the best stuff seems to be a complete gesture, the totality of the artist's body; you can really lean on it.
quotes.author: Frank Stella

quotes.quote: The art of effective listening is essential to clear communication, and clear communication is necessary to management success.
quotes.author: James Cash Penney

quotes.quote: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see.
quotes.author: Edgar Degas

quotes.quote: What I dream of is an art of balance, of purity and serenity devoid of troubling or depressing subject matter - a soothing, calming influence on the mind, rather like a good armchair which provides relaxation from physical fatigue.
quotes.author: Henri Matisse

quotes.quote: Art has the power to transform, to illuminate, to educate, inspire and motivate.
quotes.author: Harvey Fierstein

quotes.quote: Wherever the art of medicine is loved, there is also a love of humanity.
quotes.author: Hippocrates

quotes.quote: The art of war is simple enough. Find out where your enemy is. Get at him as soon as you can. Strike him as hard as you can, and keep moving on.
quotes.author: Ulysses S. Grant

quotes.quote: In mathematics the art of proposing a question must be held of higher value than solving it.
quotes.author: Georg Cantor

quotes.quote: Don't you know that every perfect life would mean the end of art?
quotes.author: Robert Musil

quotes.quote: When hospitality becomes an art it loses its very soul.
quotes.author: Max Beerbohm

quotes.quote: Art is man's constant effort to create for himself a different order of reality from that which is given to him.
quotes.author: Chinua Achebe

quotes.quote: It'll be the Internet and piracy that will kill film. There's a philosophy that the Internet should be free, but the reality is that piracy will destroy the film industry and film as an art form because it's expensive to make a movie. Maybe you'll have funky little independent movies, and it'll go back and then start up again some other way.
quotes.author: Helen Mirren

quotes.quote: I think art is not an ornament or refinement at the fringes of human intelligence, I think it's at the center. It's at the core.
quotes.author: Robert Pinsky

quotes.quote: The mark of all good art is not that the thing done is done exactly or finely, for machinery may do as much, but that it is worked out with the head and the workman's heart.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: An art book is a museum without walls.
quotes.author: Andre Malraux

quotes.quote: My life is a monument to procrastination, to the art of putting things off until later, or much later, or possibly never.
quotes.author: Craig Brown

quotes.quote: If my art has nothing to do with people's pain and sorrow, what is 'art' for?
quotes.author: Ai Weiwei

quotes.quote: Real artists take the misery and sadness of life and translate it into art.
quotes.author: Josh Peck

quotes.quote: Wild oats will get sown some time, and one of the arts of life is to sow them at the right time.
quotes.author: Richard Le Gallienne

quotes.quote: Well, Art is Art, isn't it? Still, on the other hand, water is water. And east is east and west is west and if you take cranberries and stew them like applesauce they taste much more like prunes than rhubarb does. Now you tell me what you know.
quotes.author: Groucho Marx

quotes.quote: When thou art above measure angry, bethink thee how momentary is man's life.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: The beginning of a friendship, the fact that two people out of the thousands around them can meet and connect and become friends, seems like a kind of magic to me. But maintaining a friendship requires work. I don't mean that as a bad thing. Good art requires work as well.
quotes.author: Charles de Lint

quotes.quote: The art challenges the technology, and the technology inspires the art.
quotes.author: John Lasseter

quotes.quote: A beautiful lady is an accident of nature. A beautiful old lady is a work of art.
quotes.author: Louis Nizer

quotes.quote: The human soul is hungry for beauty; we seek it everywhere - in landscape, music, art, clothes, furniture, gardening, companionship, love, religion, and in ourselves. No one would desire not to be beautiful. When we experience the beautiful, there is a sense of homecoming.
quotes.author: John O'Donohue

quotes.quote: Art lies by its own artifice.
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.quote: I adore art... when I am alone with my notes, my heart pounds and the tears stream from my eyes, and my emotion and my joys are too much to bear.
quotes.author: Giuseppe Verdi

quotes.quote: No matter what is happening in life or in the world - war, natural disaster, poor health, pain, the death of loved ones - if existence is filled with art, music and literature, life will be fulfilling, a joy.
quotes.author: Karen DeCrow

quotes.quote: There hasn't been anything real since grunge. That was the last movement led by music or an art form.
quotes.author: Daphne Guinness

quotes.quote: Whenever we witness art in a building, we are aware of an energy contained by it.
quotes.author: Arthur Erickson

quotes.quote: If commercialization is putting my art on a shirt so that a kid who can't afford a $30,000 painting can buy one, then I'm all for it.
quotes.author: Keith Haring

quotes.quote: As a composer and as a musician I'm a true believer - and this is not to be overly diplomatic - I'm a believer that there's artistry in everything from a lawn gnome to a desk chair to a symphony to an Andy Warhol painting. There's art in absolutely everything.
quotes.author: Darren Criss

quotes.quote: Art is man's expression of his joy in labor.
quotes.author: Henry A. Kissinger

quotes.quote: The history of art is the history of revivals.
quotes.author: Samuel Butler

quotes.quote: The beauty one can find in art is one of the pitifully few real and lasting products of human endeavor.
quotes.author: J. Paul Getty

quotes.quote: I don't believe in art. I believe in artists.
quotes.author: Marcel Duchamp

quotes.quote: My love of fine art increased - the more of it I saw, the more of it I wanted to see.
quotes.author: J. Paul Getty

quotes.quote: I've never really had a hobby, unless you count art, which the IRS once told me I had to declare as a hobby since I hadn't made money with it.
quotes.author: Laurie Anderson

quotes.quote: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.quote: Art depends on luck and talent.
quotes.author: Francis Ford Coppola

quotes.quote: Art is nature speeded up and God slowed down.
quotes.author: Malcolm de Chazal

quotes.quote: Great art is an instant arrested in eternity.
quotes.author: James Huneker

quotes.quote: I realize that protest paintings are not exactly in vogue, but I've done many.
quotes.author: Robert Indiana

quotes.quote: Murals in restaurants are on a par with the food in museums.
quotes.author: Peter De Vries

quotes.quote: I think of my peace paintings as one long poem, with each painting being a single stanza.
quotes.author: Robert Indiana

quotes.quote: The Japanese have a wonderful sense of design and a refinement in their art. They try to produce beautiful paintings with the minimum number of strokes.
quotes.author: David Rockefeller

quotes.quote: Art is an invention of aesthetics, which in turn is an invention of philosophers... What we call art is a game.
quotes.author: Octavio Paz

quotes.quote: The philistine provides the best definition of art. Anything that makes him rage is first class.
quotes.author: Louis Dudek

quotes.quote: Art is subject to arbitrary fashion.
quotes.author: Kary Mullis

quotes.quote: I'm not gonna give the British Government the joy of keeping taxing me. They don't tax art. And all my cars are just a collection of art.
quotes.author: Jay Kay

quotes.quote: When artists make art, they shouldn't question whether it is permissible to do one thing or another.
quotes.author: Sol LeWitt

quotes.quote: The artist belongs to his work, not the work to the artist.
quotes.author: Novalis

quotes.quote: Art is magic delivered from the lie of being truth.
quotes.author: Theodor Adorno

quotes.quote: All great art is born of the metropolis.
quotes.author: Ezra Pound

quotes.quote: If you're reading this...Congratulations, you're alive.If that's not something to smile about,then I don't know what is.
quotes.author: Chad Sugg,  Monsters Under Your Head

quotes.quote: In an artwork you're always looking for artistic decisions, so an ashtray is perfect. An ashtray has got life and death.
quotes.author: Damien Hirst

quotes.quote: An artist carries on throughout his life a mysterious, uninterrupted conversation with his public.
quotes.author: Maurice Chevalier

quotes.quote: Procrastination is the art of keeping up with yesterday.
quotes.author: Don Marquis

quotes.quote: Sometimes being a friend means mastering the art of timing. There is a time for silence. A time to let go and allow people to hurl themselves into their own destiny. And a time to prepare to pick up the pieces when it's all over.
quotes.author: Octavia Butler

quotes.quote: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Building art is a synthesis of life in materialised form. We should try to bring in under the same hat not a splintered way of thinking, but all in harmony together.
quotes.author: Alvar Aalto

quotes.quote: The human foot is a masterpiece of engineering and a work of art.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.quote: The mother art is architecture. Without an architecture of our own we have no soul of our own civilization.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.quote: Originality is the fine art of remembering what you hear but forgetting where you heard it.
quotes.author: Laurence J. Peter

quotes.quote: Silent pictures show us how we lived and what our attitudes were. And as an art form, they can be wonderfully entertaining and often inspirational.
quotes.author: Kevin Brownlow

quotes.quote: Art cannot result from sophisticated, frivolous, or superficial effects.
quotes.author: Hans Hofmann

quotes.quote: The modern work of art, as I have said, is a symbol.
quotes.author: Herbert Read

quotes.quote: Art will never be able to exist without nature.
quotes.author: Pierre Bonnard

quotes.quote: Animation is not the art of drawings that move but the art of movements that are drawn.
quotes.author: Norman McLaren

quotes.quote: I enjoy going out by myself... always have, always will. I don't have security guards, and, for the most part, I enjoy meeting new people. I see myself as a regular guy who likes playing video games with his nieces and nephews and poker with his family. I don't have an art collection or take exotic vacations. I enjoy being at home.
quotes.author: Vince Vaughn

quotes.quote: Architecture is a visual art, and the buildings speak for themselves.
quotes.author: Julia Morgan

quotes.quote: I refuse to confide and don't like it when people write about art.
quotes.author: Balthus

quotes.quote: The art of leadership is saying no, not saying yes. It is very easy to say yes.
quotes.author: Tony Blair

quotes.quote: Only in art will the lion lie down with the lamb, and the rose grow without thorn.
quotes.author: Martin Amis

quotes.quote: Were I called on to define, very briefly, the term Art, I should call it 'the reproduction of what the Senses perceive in Nature through the veil of the soul.' The mere imitation, however accurate, of what is in Nature, entitles no man to the sacred name of 'Artist.'
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: To injure an opponent is to injure yourself. To control aggression without inflicting injury is the Art of Peace.
quotes.author: Morihei Ueshiba

quotes.quote: Those who gave thee a body, furnished it with weakness; but He who gave thee Soul, armed thee with resolution. Employ it, and thou art wise; be wise and thou art happy.
quotes.author: Akhenaton

quotes.quote: Be true to yourself. Make each day a masterpiece. Help others. Drink deeply from good books. Make friendship a fine art. Build a shelter against a rainy day.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: What the mass media offers is not popular art, but entertainment which is intended to be consumed like food, forgotten, and replaced by a new dish.
quotes.author: W. H. Auden

quotes.quote: Diplomacy is the art of saying 'Nice doggie' until you can find a rock.
quotes.author: Will Rogers

quotes.quote: She had lost the art of conversation but not, unfortunately, the power of speech.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: I wanted to start a revolution, using art to build the sort of society I myself envisioned.
quotes.author: Yayoi Kusama

quotes.quote: Good management is the art of making problems so interesting and their solutions so constructive that everyone wants to get to work and deal with them.
quotes.author: Paul Hawken

quotes.quote: Art! Who comprehends her? With whom can one consult concerning this great goddess?
quotes.author: Ludwig van Beethoven

quotes.quote: With an apple I will astonish Paris.
quotes.author: Paul Cezanne

quotes.quote: Every production of an artist should be the expression of an adventure of his soul.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham

quotes.quote: I'm afraid that if you look at a thing long enough, it loses all of its meaning.
quotes.author: Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: I never called my work an 'art'. It's part of show business, the business of building entertainment.
quotes.author: Walt Disney

quotes.quote: I have loved the stars too fondly to be fearful of the night.
quotes.author: Sarah Williams

quotes.quote: You don't take a photograph, you make it.
quotes.author: Ansel Adams

quotes.quote: The more horrifying this world becomes, the more art becomes abstract.
quotes.author: Ellen Key

quotes.quote: Art doesn't transform. It just plain forms.
quotes.author: Roy Lichtenstein

quotes.quote: Once an object has been incorporated in a picture it accepts a new destiny.
quotes.author: Georges Braque

quotes.quote: To want friendship is a great fault. Friendship ought to be a gratuitous joy, like the joys afforded by art or life.
quotes.author: Simone Weil

quotes.quote: A guilty conscience needs to confess. A work of art is a confession.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: A good painting to me has always been like a friend. It keeps me company, comforts and inspires.
quotes.author: Hedy Lamarr

quotes.quote: A writer should write with his eyes and a painter paint with his ears.
quotes.author: Gertrude Stein

quotes.quote: Love the art in yourself and not yourself in the art.
quotes.author: Constantin Stanislavski

quotes.quote: Painting is by nature a luminous language.
quotes.author: Robert Delaunay

quotes.quote: Art is a collaboration between God and the artist, and the less the artist does the better.
quotes.author: Andre Gide

quotes.quote: Painting is an infinitely minute part of my personality.
quotes.author: Salvador Dali

quotes.quote: So vast is art, so narrow human wit.
quotes.author: Alexander Pope

quotes.quote: Art is either plagiarism or revolution.
quotes.author: Paul Gauguin

quotes.quote: Drawing is like making an expressive gesture with the advantage of permanence.
quotes.author: Henri Matisse

quotes.quote: You begin with the possibilities of the material.
quotes.author: Robert Rauschenberg

quotes.quote: Painting is easy when you don't know how, but very difficult when you do.
quotes.author: Edgar Degas

quotes.quote: An artist is a dreamer consenting to dream of the actual world.
quotes.author: George Santayana

quotes.quote: If a building becomes architecture, then it is art.
quotes.author: Arne Jacobsen

quotes.quote: Lying in bed would be an altogether perfect and supreme experience if only one had a colored pencil long enough to draw on the ceiling.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: A picture is worth a thousand words.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.quote: Art is the right hand of Nature. The latter has only given us being, the former has made us men.
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.quote: I could never figure out why photography and art had separate histories. So I decided to explore both.
quotes.author: John Baldessari

quotes.quote: I have had this longstanding interest in going back to school to get a Ph.D. in art history. I was especially interested in exploring this idea of the ecstatic impulse in an artist.
quotes.author: Jandy Nelson

quotes.quote: If a work of art is rich and vital and complete, those who have artistic instincts will see its beauty, and those to whom ethics appeal more strongly than aesthetics will see its moral lesson. It will fill the cowardly with terror, and the unclean will see in it their own shame.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Creating a wonderful drama is an art form, while comedy is just entertainment.
quotes.author: Jason Reitman

quotes.quote: People are craving this great progress in electronics, going after computers, the Internet, etc. It's a giant progress technologically. But they must have a balance of soul, a balance for human beauty. That means art has an important role.
quotes.author: Mstislav Rostropovich

quotes.quote: I look at a lot of artists. I'm inspired by - I suppose I shouldn't say 'inspired,' but it's not really influenced. I am inspired. Art comes from art.
quotes.author: Cy Twombly

quotes.quote: I collect art. I just recently bought two gorgeous photographs of Marilyn Monroe by international photographer Eve Arnold and I know it sounds horrible but when she dies all her pictures are going to be worth triple. But I won't tell you how much I got them for - let's just say it was a lot.
quotes.author: Melanie Brown

quotes.quote: I believe that an art exhibition can be engaging, fun and deeply intellectually satisfying and serious. These are not contradictory concepts in art.
quotes.author: Jeffrey Deitch

quotes.quote: Game design is a funny thing. There are people out there who are really good at it, but it's not clear that they can teach it. It's a very intuitive process. It's an art.
quotes.author: Luis von Ahn

quotes.quote: Painting is poetry that is seen rather than felt, and poetry is painting that is felt rather than seen.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.quote: Music is one of the noblest callings I can think of. It's the highest of all the art forms to me. For example, if my kid said to me, 'I want to give it all up,' whatever it is that they're doing, 'and I want to take my saxophone and go out,' I would say, 'May God go with you. This is a great and noble thing that you're doing.'
quotes.author: Hugh Laurie

quotes.quote: Women are our most miraculous muse, an enchanted intangibility that encourages all art.
quotes.author: CeeLo Green

quotes.quote: I look at art as a container. You can't get inside it, so you have to ask all of these questions.
quotes.author: Mark Bradford

quotes.quote: One of the most amazing things about mathematics is the people who do math aren't usually interested in application, because mathematics itself is truly a beautiful art form. It's structures and patterns, and that's what we love, and that's what we get off on.
quotes.author: Danica McKellar

quotes.quote: The work of art is a scream of freedom.
quotes.author: Christo

quotes.quote: Art is I; science is we.
quotes.author: Claude Bernard

quotes.quote: There are times when the art world seems like a religious empire. There are great cathedral galleries and pilgrimage sites where treasured art pieces are displayed like holy relics, and this can certainly be a great pleasure on a rainy Sunday afternoon.
quotes.author: Michael Leunig

quotes.quote: Rhetoric may be defined as the faculty of observing in any given case the available means of persuasion. This is not a function of any other art.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: To be nobody but yourself in a world which is doing its best day and night to make you like everybody else means to fight the hardest battle which any human being can fight and never stop fighting.
quotes.author: E.E. Cummings

quotes.quote: Art is the imposing of a pattern on experience, and our aesthetic enjoyment is recognition of the pattern.
quotes.author: Alfred North Whitehead
